messages:
amy.sales: Starting POC handoff for AcmeCorp. They want live logs + trace correlation pushed to Splunk HEC and a short runthrough during demo on Tuesday. They reported some 502s when trying to forward initially. Need checklist + minimal config. @raj.engineer @tess.sre @zoe.security

raj.engineer: Quick checklist from infra side: 1) confirm HEC URL and token 2) TLS ok (we validate certs by default) 3) enable trace headers in requests (x-redwood-trace / x-request-id) 4) set drain sample_rate and error-always rules 5) confirm firewall (our outbound IPs) or token-only. What HEC URL/token do they have?

amy.sales: They provided https://splunk.acmecorp.internal:8088/services/collector and a token. They said their infra initially saw intermittent 502s when we sent batched payloads.

mike.eng: 502s typically mean their collector dropped large batches or TLS handshake issue. For POC, recommend smaller batch_size and keepalive offloading. Also set preserve_client_timestamps so Splunk keeps original time for correlation.

raj.engineer: Minimal drain JSON you can paste to their ticket (replace <TOKEN>):

```
{
  "type": "http_hec",
  "url": "https://splunk.acmecorp.internal:8088/services/collector",
  "auth": {"type":"token","token":"<TOKEN>"},
  "tls_verify": true,
  "batch_size": 100,
  "batch_interval_ms": 500,
  "sample_rate": 1.0,
  "always_send_levels": ["error","fatal"],
  "preserve_client_timestamps": true,
  "headers": {"X-Redwood-Trace":"{{trace_id}}","X-Request-ID":"{{request_id}}"}
}
```

raj.engineer: For POC reduce batch_size to 20-50 if they keep returning 502s. If TLS fails, ask for their cert chain or allowlist our IPs.

zoe.security: Security note: token-only HEC is fine for demo. If they want IP allowlist, we'll provide Redwood outbound IP CIDRs. For private builds we require mTLS; does Acme require that?

amy.sales: They said token is fine for now. No mTLS.

tess.sre: I'll watch rate limits during the demo. If they plan 1k concurrent workers, we should either: a) increase org burst for a 2-hour window or b) route demo traffic to a small Dedicated pool. Which do they want?

amy.sales: Prefer we keep hosted but bump burst. Demo is 2 hours, expected peak ~900 concurrent.

tess.sre: I can temporarily relax per-org burst to 1.5x for that window. Also add a runbook with rollback steps. I'll add retriable status codes to the runbook (429, 503) and advise client-side retry with exponential backoff + jitter.

mike.eng: SDK note: our JS/Go SDKs automatically retry 429s up to 3 times; for POC we can bump to 6 retries and backoff base 200ms with full jitter. Also expose Retry-After if present.

amy.sales: Can you give me the curl check the customer can run to validate HEC ingestion and trace join?

raj.engineer: Sure: 

```
curl -k -H "Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event":"redwood_test","trace_id":"acme-demo-1","request_id":"req-1"}' \
  https://splunk.acmecorp.internal:8088/services/collector
```

raj.engineer: Then in Splunk: `search trace_id="acme-demo-1" | stats count by source, trace_id, request_id` should return the event.

amy.sales: They also asked if we can only forward errors plus a small sample to save egress.

mike.eng: Yes. Set `sample_rate` to 0.05 and `always_send_levels` to include error/critical. That combination sends all errors and a 5% sample of everything else. Good for POC.

zoe.security: Also check logging PII rules. If they want entire payloads forwarded, confirm there are no user-sensitive fields. We can apply a redaction filter in the drain config (e.g., remove `user.email`, `user_ssn`).

amy.sales: They requested a quick screenshot flow for the demo showing "trace -> logs" correlation; can we pre-populate a saved search & dashboard tile?

mike.eng: Yes. Steps for the demo: 1) In Console -> Observability -> Traces, pick a sample trace id (we'll produce 3 trace IDs) 2) Click from trace to logs panel, saved search: `trace_id="<trace_id>"` 3) Dashboard tile: logs table + trace waterfall. I'll create the tile under /dashboards/poc-acmecorp and attach sample traces.

tess.sre: I've created a runbook (rb_acme_logs_2026) with rollback and throttling steps. I also scheduled a short smoke test 30m before the demo. obs-bot will post status.

obs-bot: observability-bot: Runbook created rb_acme_logs_2026, scheduled smoke test at 2026-03-22T15:30Z

amy.sales: Amazing. One last Q: if they see 502s again during smoke test, what's fastest mitigation?

raj.engineer: Fastest: lower batch_size to 20 and reduce batch_interval_ms to 200ms, plus enable keepalive and switch to plaintext small posts. If that fails, route demo to Dedicated pool or increase burst as a last resort.

amy.sales: Thanks team, I'll push the drain config and the curl check to their infra ticket and circle back after the smoke test :rocket:
